Results.ReviewText: I've been trying to get help for a grill for over a week. I've called nearly a dozen times, as customer support agents often hang up on me (mind you it sounds accidental, so perhaps it's a poor system on their end). My case has been escalated three times now with promises to provide me support within 48 hours each time, and each time I wind up calling again 36 hours later as they have not provided me with the help they promised. I haven't even tried the grill because I'm spending so long on the admin of trying to get help. I'm sure the grill is good, but quite frankly I'd take business elsewhere as its impossible to get help if anything goes wrong. At the very least, do not buy the product through the official Weber site.
Results.Title: Absolutely horrible customer service

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback with us. We truly appreciate you sharing your experience and providing insight into your expectations for the 22'' Salute to Service Kettle. We value feedback from longtime Weber owners, and your comments regarding the materials, cooking grate, and lid fit are important to us. We are sorry the kettle did not meet your expectations, and we appreciate you bringing these concerns to our attention.

Results.ReviewText: I purchased the 22” Salute to Service Kettle during a Fourth of July sale at Home Depot. It was quite apparent during assembly that the quality of materials was lower than the 10 year old 22” Weber kettle I was replacing. The metal parts are not as robust, coatings don’t seem to be as thick and the cooking grate is much thinner than the old one. After assembly I noted that the lid doesn’t fit well on the kettle because it appeared to be sprung (out of round). I have not yet had a chance to use the new kettle grill but I intend to use the old cooking grate because it is much more substantial. I’m not sure I would buy another one in the future, especially at full price!
Results.Title: Not made like they used to be

Results.ReviewText: Had to replace my 1st Weber I had for 23+ years after a tree fell on it during an Alaskan wind storm.  Never a question what I was going to get: Another one of the original, the classic, Weber kettle.  Love it!
